offers_products.reason: Sells EXPAREL, ZILRETTA and iovera° non-opioid pain drugs and devices; manufactures them.

offers_services.reason: Revenue comes from pharmaceutical products; no main service offering beyond education and support.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Products are administered by surgeons and clinicians and bought by hospitals and surgery centers, not chosen by patients.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sold to hospitals, ambulatory surgery centers and physician practices, via distributors.

cyclical_demand.reason: Postsurgical and chronic pain treatments are medically necessary, though elective surgery volumes can dip somewhat.

big_ticket.reason: Single-dose injectable drugs bought frequently per procedure; small per-unit purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for patented drug products, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Buyers are hospitals, surgery centers and physician practices, many mid-sized or independent, via wholesalers.

asset_heavy.reason: Pharma company with own manufacturing but growth driven by R&D and sales, not heavy plants or fleets.

notes: Large-customer answer is borderline, since hospital systems and group purchasers are significant buyers.
